notes.title: Tails of Trainspot is officially joining forces with indie.io!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Tails of Trainspot is officially joining forces with indie.io![/b][/p][p]Dear players, we are thrilled to announce that Tails of Trainspot has officially partnered with indie.io![/p][p][/p][p][b]About Our Game[/b][/p][p]Tails of Trainspot was born from our love for number puzzles and animal adventure stories. When we began conceptualizing this project, we aimed to create a delightful gaming experience that combines lighthearted, adorable animal stories with deep puzzle mechanics. Seeing players' enthusiastic reactions when trying our game at conventions has been the driving force that keeps us moving forward. With fluffy, cute animals and cool, retro mechanical trains, we believe every player will find their own joy in Tails of Trainspot.[/p][p][/p][p][b]About Game Publishers[/b][/p][p]For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Why We Chose indie.io[/b][/p][p]We've been looking for a partner who could help us bring Tails of Trainspot to more players. indie.io has an excellent track record of helping other indie games reach more players. We firmly believe this partnership will allow more gaming enthusiasts to discover our game. Don't forget to check out [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio"]indie.io's Steam Publisher page[/url][/u], where you'll find many other excellent indie game titles waiting to be discovered![/p][p][/p][p][b]Join Our Community![/b][/p][p]We're also currently working on our new project, [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3539480/Back_of_Beyond/"]Back of Beyond[/url][/u]![/p][p]Please don't forget to follow and wishlist the game, and feel free to join our [u][url="https://discord.gg/RFT8R8KA"]Discord community[/url][/u] to be the first to receive future announcements![/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]
